permutationLabel: Elderly diabetic woman, ECG shows inferior STEMI
summary: 71-year-old diabetic woman with CKD, 6 h upper abdominal discomfort and nausea, HR 48, BP 92/58; ECG: ST elevation II, III, aVF; troponin 412.

inputs.hpi: 6 hours of upper abdominal discomfort, nausea and tiredness; thought it was 'gastric flu'. Diabetic with chronic kidney disease. Brought in by her son because she looked pale.

exam.general: Pale, clammy. Temperature 36.5°C, pulse 48/min, BP 92/58, SpO2 94%.

imaging.name: 12-lead ECG
imaging.result: Sinus bradycardia 48/min, ST elevation in II, III and aVF with reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL — inferior STEMI.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Inferior STEMI (ST elevation II, III, aVF; troponin 412) presenting as upper abdominal discomfort — primary PCI pathway now.

mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: Web: PANE has no cardiac (ACS/MI) disease node, so it can never appear in the PANE top 3 (cholecystitis, peptic ulcer, GORD).

emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: Web: adaptiveTriage: 'same_day_call' (score 30); the resulted ECG (ST elevation) and troponin 412 are not triage inputs, and HR 48/SBP 92 are inside the vital thresholds. iOS: ClinicalPathwayEngine reads only CC/PMH keywords; CC 'Upper abdominal discomfort and nausea' gives 'routine'.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Feed resulted ECG/troponin into triage and prompts ('ST elevation', troponin above the 99th centile → emergency, STEMI pathway).

mustAlarm.knownGapNote: Web: No prompt reads ECG results or troponin; the only safety prompt is bradycardia.
mustAlarm.proposedFix: Same: an ECG/troponin rule in computeClinicalPrompts.

mustInclude.knownGapNote: Web: No reperfusion/PCI action; ICD I21.19 has no protocol.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add an I21 protocol (primary PCI, antiplatelets, cardiology) for the plan tab.

mustExclude.note: A GI work-up for a STEMI wastes the reperfusion window.

guideline.name: ESC guidelines — acute coronary syndromes (2023)
guideline.section: 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes of first medical contact; hs-troponin; inferior STEMI (right-sided leads); primary PCI
guideline.citation: Byrne RA, Rossello X, Coughlan JJ, et al. 2023 ESC guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes. Eur Heart J. 2023;44:3720–826.

rationale: Permutation: elderly diabetic woman (atypical symptoms) with the ECG already recorded. Tests whether a resulted ECG and troponin change the engines' output from a GI to a cardiac emergency.

authoring.author: Claude (GI surgical emergencies cluster)
authoring.notes: Expectations need surgeon sign-off (reviewedBy). Every citation is verified: false.
